Important information regarding Link Play:

The Nintendo Account Agreement and the Nintendo Community
Guidelines apply to all user-generated content and player
conduct.

If content or activities that violate these terms are reported and
confirmed, it may result in server data being blocked and/or
access to Link Play being restricted.

Additionally, please note that the creator of a Cloud Island is
responsible for any content on their Cloud Island. Please exercise
caution when sharing your Link Code for a Cloud Island.

You can report inappropriate content or behavior by selecting
“Send a report” on the menu screen during Link Play.

Please follow the Nintendo Account Agreement and the Nintendo
Community Guidelines and be respectful of other players while
you are playing.
